original: The only reason my voice reached you was because you were searching for me。 It is no different from right now。。。
contexto:
Dialogue. Adjacent lines in the same event:
And once again、 we have become one。 Just like when you decided you wanted to become the Maiden of Light in the caves back at Vinaigrette。
That is why you looked deep within your heart and called out to me? Telling me not to forget。。。
Even after your heart fell into darkness and you lost sight of your true self、 you still remembered me。
My true self、 huh。。。 You know、 I never realized it before。
